summary: The diff implements 6 out of 7 requirements. REQ-1 (address update) is fully implemented. REQ-3 (haptic/beep), REQ-4 (auto-quantity increment), REQ-5 (scanning overlay), and REQ-7 (camera permission description) are implemented. REQ-2 (replacing Quagga2 with zero-latency scanner) is NOT implemented—the code still uses Quagga2 from CDN. REQ-6 (payment gateway sync) has partial backend support via new payment fields, but no explicit frontend payment gateway integration is visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace the current Quagga2 barcode scanner with a zero-latency, high-performance scanner that uses enhanced decoding algorithms capable of reading barcodes even when blurred, tilted, or in low-light conditions
missing_requirements.reason: The BarcodeScanner.tsx component still loads Quagga2 from CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ericblade/quagga2@1.12.1/dist/quagga.min.js) and initializes it with window.Quagga. The requirement explicitly requested replacing Quagga2 with a high-performance, zero-latency scanner.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the final bill total is synced with the payment gateway for seamless checkout after barcode scanning is complete and the bill is generated
missing_requirements.reason: While backend migration adds payment-related fields (paymentStatus, paymentReference, paymentGatewayId), the diff does not show any frontend code that transmits bill totals to a payment gateway or integrates with a payment API. The BillingPage.tsx is truncated, but no explicit payment gateway sync logic is visible.
